items.name: copy-command
items.title: Copy command
items.description: A copyable command with honest clipboard feedback and a manual fallback.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: async-action
items.title: Async action
items.description: Promise-aware action with pending, success, failure and retry states.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: hold-action
items.title: Hold action
items.description: A press-and-hold confirmation button with a pixel-stepped fill and a two-step fallback for assistive technology.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: shortcut
items.title: Shortcut
items.description: Platform-aware keycaps that press with the real keys and run a handler when the combination lands.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: github-star
items.title: GitHub star
items.description: A native repository link with an app-supplied count, rolling digits, green star fill, and a bounded burst.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: filter-list
items.title: Filter list
items.description: An accessible searchable list with accent-insensitive matching and empty states.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: scrub-input
items.title: Scrub input
items.description: A numeric text field whose label scrubs the value by dragging, with a tick ruler that glides with the number.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: A one-time-code field that draws a row of cells and a block caret over a single native input.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-slider
items.title: Pixel slider
items.description: A range slider drawn as a pixel grid with a dithered fill and a green thumb column, over a native range input.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: liquid-switch
items.title: Liquid switch
items.description: A toggle switch whose thumb stretches, necks and snaps across the track like a drop of liquid.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: liquid-tabs
items.title: Liquid tabs
items.description: A keyboard-accessible segmented control with a liquid selection that stretches and snaps.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: index-row
items.title: Index row
items.description: Borderless index link with three fixed digits that roll on hover and focus.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: text-link
items.title: Text link
items.description: A normal text link with an optional keyboard-accessible Radix HoverCard preview.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A navigation row of square icon tiles that magnify around the pointer or keyboard focus from a fixed baseline.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: scroll-spy
items.title: Scroll spy
items.description: An on-this-page list of section links with a liquid marker that tracks the section at the reading line.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A numbered step indicator whose connecting line fills in pixel increments, with numbers that roll over to a pixel check and optional jump-back navigation.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pager
items.title: Pager
items.description: Pagination with previous and next arrows, a zero-padded page counter whose digits roll in the direction of travel, and a strip of page numbers.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: An accessible file tree with stepped pixel chevrons, animated folders, guide lines and full tree keyboard support.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll progress
items.description: A one-cell-tall strip of pixels pinned to the viewport edge, or inline, that fills as the page or a scroll container scrolls.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-progress
items.title: Pixel progress
items.description: An accessible pixel-grid progress bar with a dithered leading edge and an indeterminate state.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: wlkr-loader
items.title: WLKR loader
items.description: A tunable Open Lens loader with optional liquid split-body motion, a hover bounce, pause and reduced-motion support.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: toaster
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Ink-block toast notifications with a draining pixel timer, called from anywhere with toast().
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status dot
items.description: An inline status indicator: a small square dot with a label, a pixel-stepped ping when live and a caret blink when busy.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-skeleton
items.title: Pixel skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder for text, blocks and avatars, drawn as a checker texture with a stepped pixel band sweeping across.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer text
items.description: Inline status text in a quiet grey with a stepped, dithered band of brighter text passing through it while work is in progress.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling number
items.description: A formatted number whose digits roll to each new value like an odometer.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: dot-matrix
items.title: Dot matrix
items.description: A dot-matrix display with a built-in 5×7 font and stepped scrolling for long messages.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: A countdown to a target time with days, hours, minutes and seconds on rolling digit wheels, a hydration-safe placeholder and one shared wall-clock ticker.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-bars
items.title: Pixel bars
items.description: A bar chart drawn as stacks of square cells that build up on view, with a hover and keyboard readout.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: heat-grid
items.title: Heat grid
items.description: An activity grid of days by week, shaded in four ink steps with the busiest days in brand green.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-avatar
items.title: Pixel avatar
items.description: A deterministic, symmetric pixel identicon drawn from any string, with optional image and an overlapping group.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: secret-field
items.title: Secret field
items.description: A masked API key or token field that decodes on reveal, re-masks on a timer and copies without showing the value.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: page-intro
items.title: Page intro
items.description: Gallery typography with a width-stable binary heading reveal.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: decode-text
items.title: Decode text
items.description: Inline text that resolves out of glyph noise on view, hover or focus, with a stable width.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Inline text that types a phrase, holds, deletes back to the beginning it shares with the next and types that, behind a block caret.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Inline emphasis that draws a highlight, underline or strike through its words in discrete steps, across line breaks, on view, mount or hover.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A self-playing terminal session that types commands behind a block caret and lands output a row at a time, at its final height from the first frame.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: ticker
items.title: Ticker
items.description: A constant-speed marquee that eases to a stop on hover and focus, drags with momentum, and steps out at the edges.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-object
items.title: Pixel object
items.description: A projected pixel sphere, custom point cloud or mask, with rotation, flicker patterns, shape morphing and considerate motion controls.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-image
items.title: Pixel image
items.description: An image that resolves from coarse colour blocks to the real picture when it enters view.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.description: A before-and-after comparison with a draggable, clickable and keyboard-controlled divider.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-wave
items.title: Pixel wave
items.description: An audio meter of square-cell bars for listening, speaking and recording states, driven by a microphone stream, a supplied level or a simulation.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot field
items.description: A canvas dot grid that swells, tints and springs away from the pointer, with a slow ambient wave.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: dither-field
items.title: Dither field
items.description: A canvas background that renders a slow, soft light field through an ordered-dither matrix as crisp one-bit pixels, with children on top.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: pixel-trail
items.title: Pixel trail
items.description: A wrapper with an invisible grid whose cells light up under the pointer and switch off in stepped pixels, leaving a short blocky trail.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: dissolve
items.title: Dissolve
items.description: A wrapper that reveals or hides any content through a 4×4 ordered-dither mask, on view, on mount or on command.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: A wrapper that pulls its children a little way toward a nearby pointer on a spring, with a deeper parallax layer, and springs them home on leave.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: A basic shadcn Toggle that switches light and dark themes, follows the system until chosen and remembers the choice.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: footer-controls
items.title: Footer controls
items.description: Compact system, light and dark theme controls with a link to a real app-owned plain-text page for agents.
items.author: WLKR Labs

items.name: theme
items.title: WLKR theme
items.description: Semantic light and dark tokens. Typography stays with your application.

items.name: typography
items.title: WLKR typography
items.description: Opt-in exact gallery typography and layout, with semantic legacy token bridges.
